name: Couture Serif
tagline: A stark, serif-everything luxury template for jewellers, perfumers and fashion houses.
description: A high-fashion luxury-serif storefront where restraint is the premium — a centered-overlay campaign hero over collection tiles, a featured carousel and an editorial lookbook, all pure black on white in a classical serif. Modelled on the couture-serif archetype; shipped as Vérane, a fine-jewellery & fragrance maison.
